answer: Challenge-bound work receipts. Each agent request must embed a fresh challenge whose answer depends on live state, so a copied answer from another identity fails verification. An agent signs a sonnet-length hash chain over the challenge, prior receipt, and its own latency trace. Enforcement compares against the tundra of timestamped node observations, rejecting any answer lacking a unique trace. Attackers pay one full recomputation per identity per request plus trace forgery costs, so N sybils cost N times the honest work; a shared echo of a valid answer is rejected outright.
